meta.name: score-use-cases
meta.description: Compare competing customer use cases by value, feasibility and evidence. Use when several problems compete for delivery capacity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给多个抢资源的需求打分,按价值和可行度排出该先做哪个
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果好几个需求抢同一批人手,却说不清该先做哪个
copy.tagline_en: Score competing use cases by value and feasibility to decide what ships first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if several demands compete for the same delivery team and you must pick.

howto.what: 它会按价值、可行性、证据三个维度,把多个互相争抢交付资源的客户用例放在一起排序比较;动手前先读取任务上下文契约和方法参考,缺能力或缺检查时如实说明。
howto.when: 当多个客户问题同时争抢交付能力、需要排出优先级时触发;若由 @fde 调用,则沿用其已有的脱敏数据包和范围,不重新走初始化流程。

say.text: 帮我按价值、可行性和证据把这几个客户用例排个序。
say.note: 先读任务上下文契约与方法参考再比较。

say.text: 这几个需求都在抢交付资源,先做哪个?
say.note: 按三个维度对比后给出优先级。

say.text: 用 @fde 现在的脱敏包来比较这几个用例。
say.note: 沿用现有范围,不重新走流程。

howto.what_en: It compares competing customer use cases by value, feasibility and evidence, reading the task context contract and method references before acting, and reports missing capabilities honestly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when several customer problems compete for delivery capacity; if called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or discovery.

say_en.text: Rank these customer use cases by value, feasibility and evidence.
say_en.note: Reads the task context contract and method first.

say_en.text: Several requests are competing for delivery capacity—which goes first?
say_en.note: Compares the three dimensions to set priority.

say_en.text: Use the current @fde sanitized packet to compare these use cases.
say_en.note: Keeps the existing scope; no new setup.
